gloss: to sign a contract; to conclude an agreement

definitions.gloss: to sign a contract; to conclude an agreement
definitions.explanation: To formally enter into a contractual agreement with another party. A standard business expression.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}んだ。
{新|あたら}しい{取引先|とりひきさき}と{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}んだ。
examples.english: We concluded a contract with a new business partner.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}までに{賃貸|ちんたい}{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}ぶ{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: I need to sign the rental contract by next month.

notes: The verb {結|むす}ぶ literally means to tie or bind, giving the image of binding parties together in agreement. This is the standard collocation for signing contracts in Japanese. Can also be used for treaties and agreements more broadly. Related expressions: {契約|けいやく}を{交|か}わす (to exchange contracts), {契約|けいやく}を{解除|かいじょ}する (to cancel a contract).
